title: KV Packet: Recomputation-Free Context-Independent KV Caching for LLMs
authors: Chuangtao Chen; Grace Li Zhang; Xunzhao Yin; Cheng Zhuo; Bing Li; Ulf Schlichtmann
affiliations: Technical University of Munich, Technical University of Darmstadt, Zhejiang University, Technische Universität Ilmenau
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: Precomputed document KV caches are context-dependent: when retrieved documents appear under new prefixes or alongside other chunks, naive concatenation omits cross-document dependencies and severely degrades accuracy. Existing model-adaptation or selective-recomputation approaches either modify the base model or retain inference FLOPs and TTFT overhead.
problem_statement.zh: 預先計算的文件 KV cache 具有 context dependency：當檢索文件置於新的 prefix 或與其他 chunk 並列時，直接拼接會遺失跨文件依賴並大幅降低準確率。既有模型適配方法需要修改 base model，而 selective recompute 方法仍會產生 inference FLOPs 與 TTFT 開銷。

key_innovation.en: KV Packet wraps each frozen, independently cached document with lightweight trainable Header and Trailer soft-token adapters. A self-supervised distillation objective aligns packet-based outputs with a full-attention teacher while freezing the base model and document embeddings; RoPE shifts then permit direct packet concatenation without inference-time document-token recomputation.
key_innovation.zh: KV Packet 以輕量、可訓練的 Header 與 Trailer soft-token adapter 包裹每個凍結且獨立 cache 的文件。其 self-supervised distillation objective 在凍結 base model 與文件 embedding 的前提下，使 packet-based output 對齊 full-attention teacher；再以 RoPE 位移進行位置對齊，於 inference 時直接拼接各 packet，無須重算文件 token。

baselines_compared: Full Recompute, No Recompute, No Cache, CacheBlend, A3, Random recomputation, EPIC, SAM-KV, CUR, KVzap, LeverageScore, TOVA, Random pruning, Single Cache

key_improvements.en: Inference-time FLOPs are 5–6 orders of magnitude lower than Full Recompute while F1 remains comparable in most evaluated settings. On Llama, the paper reports TTFT speedups of 1.36× on Biography, 3.3× on HotpotQA, 19.45× on Needle-in-a-Haystack, and 5.81× on MusiQue.
key_improvements.zh: inference-time FLOPs 較 Full Recompute 降低 5–6 個數量級，同時在多數評測設定中維持相當的 F1。在 Llama 實驗中，論文報告 Biography、HotpotQA、Needle-in-a-Haystack 與 MusiQue 的 TTFT 分別加速 1.36×、3.3×、19.45× 與 5.81×。

reuse_metric.en: Recomputation-free reuse: no document tokens are recomputed at inference, and F1 is comparable to Full Recompute in most evaluated configurations; the paper reports a performance gap for Qwen on MusiQue.
reuse_metric.zh: 重用過程不需重算：inference 時不重算任何文件 token，且在多數評測設定中維持與 Full Recompute 相當的 F1；論文亦指出 Qwen 在 MusiQue 上仍有性能落差。
